title: 1D Steady-State Conduction Rod with Fixed Boundary Nodes
description: Four-node aluminum conduction bar connecting a heated base to a fixed 300 K thermal sink solved for steady-state temperatures with STDSTL.
code:
C 1D Steady-State Aluminum Conduction Rod
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = "1D Steady-State Conduction Rod"
  ABSZRO = 0.0
HEADER NODE DATA, ROD
  1, 350.0, 45.0   $ Heated end diffusion node
  2, 330.0, 45.0   $ Mid-rod node A
  3, 315.0, 45.0   $ Mid-rod node B
  -4, 300.0, 0.0   $ Fixed cold-plate boundary node (300 K)
HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA, ROD
  10, 1, 2, 4.0    $ Linear conduction G = kA/L (W/K)
  20, 2, 3, 4.0
  30, 3, 4, 4.0
HEADER SOURCE DATA, ROD
  1, 40.0          $ Applied heater load (W)
HEADER CONSTANTS DATA
  TIMEO = 0.0, TIMEND = 200.0, DTIMEI = 1.0
  DRLXCA = 1.0E-6, NLOOP = 100
HEADER EXECUTION
  CALL STDSTL
HEADER OUTPUT CALLS
  CALL TPRINT
END OF DATA

title: Electronics PCB Finned Heatsink Convection Network
description: Power MOSFET junction-to-ambient thermal resistance network modeling TIM interface, aluminum heatsink base, parallel convective fins, and PCB copper spread.
code:
C Power Electronics PCB and Finned Heatsink Thermal Network
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = "Electronics PCB Finned Heatsink Network"
  ABSZRO = 0.0
HEADER NODE DATA, ELEC
  1, 355.0, 12.0   $ Power MOSFET junction
  2, 340.0, 35.0   $ TO-247 case and TIM interface
  3, 330.0, 180.0  $ Aluminum heatsink baseplate
  4, 322.0, 95.0   $ Fin array outer surface
  5, 325.0, 65.0   $ FR-4 PCB copper ground plane
  -99, 298.15, 0.0 $ Forced-air ambient sink (25 C)
HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA, ELEC
  10, 1, 2, 1.8    $ Junction-to-case conductance (W/K)
  11, 2, 3, 3.2    $ TIM interface conductance (W/K)
  12, 3, 4, 12.5   $ Base-to-fin conduction (W/K)
  13, 4, 99, 2.4   $ Forced convection off fins (W/K)
  14, 2, 5, 0.65   $ Leadframe conduction to PCB (W/K)
  15, 5, 99, 0.45  $ Natural convection from PCB (W/K)
HEADER SOURCE DATA, ELEC
  1, 45.0          $ MOSFET switching and conduction loss (W)
HEADER CONSTANTS DATA
  TIMEO = 0.0, TIMEND = 300.0, DTIMEI = 1.0
  DRLXCA = 1.0E-6, NLOOP = 150
HEADER EXECUTION
  CALL STDSTL
  CALL CRANKN
HEADER OUTPUT CALLS
  CALL TPRINT
END OF DATA

title: Spacecraft Radiator Panel Solar-Flux and Space-Sink Radiation
description: Spacecraft avionics box coupled through heat pipes to a white-paint Z-93 radiator panel rejecting heat via Stefan-Boltzmann radiation to 4 K deep space.
code:
C Spacecraft Avionics Radiator Panel with Space-Sink Radiation
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = "Spacecraft Radiator Panel Thermal Network"
  ABSZRO = 0.0
  SIGMA = 5.670374419D-8
HEADER NODE DATA, RAD
  1, 310.0, 1200.0 $ Avionics payload baseplate
  2, 305.0, 450.0  $ Embedded ammonia heat pipe saddle
  3, 295.0, 680.0  $ Honeycomb radiator facesheet (1.5 m2)
  4, 290.0, 0.0    $ Radiator arithmetic surface node
  -100, 4.0, 0.0   $ Deep space radiation sink (4 K)
HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA, RAD
  10, 1, 2, 18.0   $ Bolted interface conductance (W/K)
  11, 2, 3, 25.0   $ Heat-pipe effective conductance (W/K)
  12, 3, 4, 42.0   $ Facesheet through-thickness conduction
  -20, 4, 100, 1.38 $ Radiation RADK = eps*A*F (0.92 * 1.5 * 1.0)
HEADER SOURCE DATA, RAD
  1, 240.0         $ Avionics internal dissipation (W)
  4, 65.0          $ Absorbed solar + Earth IR environmental load (W)
HEADER CONSTANTS DATA
  TIMEO = 0.0, TIMEND = 1800.0, DTIMEI = 5.0
  DRLXCA = 1.0E-6, NLOOP = 200
HEADER EXECUTION
  CALL STDSTL
  CALL CRANKN
HEADER OUTPUT CALLS
  CALL TPRINT
END OF DATA

title: CubeSat 6-Face Orbital Eclipse Transient Thermal Model
description: 3U CubeSat six-face aluminum chassis and internal Li-ion battery pack cycling through a 90-minute LEO sunlit-to-eclipse orbit with radiation to space.
code:
C 3U CubeSat 6-Face Orbital Eclipse Transient Thermal Model
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = "3U CubeSat 6-Face LEO Orbital Thermal Model"
  ABSZRO = 0.0
  SIGMA = 5.670374419D-8
HEADER NODE DATA, CUBESAT
  1, 295.0, 140.0  $ +X solar panel face
  2, 285.0, 140.0  $ -X nadir face
  3, 290.0, 140.0  $ +Y ram face
  4, 288.0, 140.0  $ -Y wake face
  5, 292.0, 60.0   $ +Z zenith endcap
  6, 286.0, 60.0   $ -Z nadir endcap
  10, 298.0, 420.0 $ Internal battery and OBC stack
  -999, 3.0, 0.0   $ Deep space radiation boundary (3 K)
HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA, CUBESAT
  101, 1, 10, 0.45 $ Frame rail conduction
  102, 2, 10, 0.45
  103, 3, 10, 0.45
  104, 4, 10, 0.45
  105, 5, 10, 0.30
  106, 6, 10, 0.30
  107, 1, 3, 0.25  $ Panel edge contact
  108, 2, 4, 0.25
  -201, 1, 999, 0.0255 $ +X radiation to space (0.03 m2 * 0.85)
  -202, 2, 999, 0.0255
  -203, 3, 999, 0.0255
  -204, 4, 999, 0.0255
  -205, 5, 999, 0.0085 $ +Z radiation to space (0.01 m2 * 0.85)
  -206, 6, 999, 0.0085
HEADER SOURCE DATA, CUBESAT
  1, 14.5          $ Absorbed solar load on +X array (W)
  2, 3.2           $ Earth IR + albedo on nadir face (W)
  10, 8.5          $ OBC, transceiver, and battery dissipation (W)
HEADER ARRAY DATA
  101, 0.0, 1800.0, 3300.0, 3360.0, 5400.0
  102, 14.5, 14.5, 14.5, 0.0, 0.0
HEADER CONSTANTS DATA
  TIMEO = 0.0, TIMEND = 5400.0, DTIMEI = 10.0
  DRLXCA = 1.0E-6, NLOOP = 200
HEADER EXECUTION
  CALL STDSTL
  CALL CRANKN
HEADER OUTPUT CALLS
  CALL TPRINT
END OF DATA

title: Deep-Space Cryogenic Telescope MLI Thermal Bus
description: Sunshielded deep-space infrared telescope thermal architecture linking a 290 K spacecraft bus through multi-layer insulation (MLI) and V-groove shields to a 40 K focal-plane detector.
code:
C Deep-Space Infrared Telescope Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI) Bus
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = "Deep-Space Cryogenic Telescope MLI Bus"
  ABSZRO = 0.0
  SIGMA = 5.670374419D-8
HEADER NODE DATA, CRYO
  1, 290.0, 4500.0 $ Warm spacecraft service bus (290 K)
  2, 210.0, 320.0  $ Sunshield layer 1 (warm side)
  3, 140.0, 260.0  $ Sunshield layer 2 (intermediate)
  4, 85.0,  220.0  $ Sunshield layer 3 (cold side)
  5, 58.0,  850.0  $ Telescope optical baffle tube
  6, 42.0,  180.0  $ SiC primary mirror assembly
  7, 38.0,  45.0   $ Infrared focal-plane array (FPA)
  -100, 3.0, 0.0   $ Deep space radiative sink (3 K)
  -200, 35.0, 0.0  $ Pulse-tube cryocooler cold tip (35 K)
HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA, CRYO
  10, 1, 2, 0.08   $ Low-conductivity G10 bipod struts (W/K)
  11, 2, 3, 0.05
  12, 3, 4, 0.04
  13, 4, 5, 0.025
  14, 5, 6, 0.15   $ Baffle-to-mirror mount
  15, 6, 7, 0.06   $ Mirror-to-FPA thermal strap
  16, 7, 200, 1.25 $ Copper braid to cryocooler cold tip
  -20, 1, 2, 0.045 $ MLI effective radiation e*=0.015 * 3.0 m2
  -21, 2, 3, 0.030
  -22, 3, 4, 0.025
  -23, 4, 5, 0.018
  -24, 1, 100, 1.85 $ Warm bus radiator to space
  -25, 2, 100, 0.40 $ V-groove edge radiation to space
  -26, 3, 100, 0.40
  -27, 4, 100, 0.45
  -28, 5, 100, 1.20 $ Cold baffle exterior radiation to space
HEADER SOURCE DATA, CRYO
  1, 420.0         $ Bus electronics + solar input (W)
  2, 18.0          $ Residual solar absorption on shield 1 (W)
  7, 0.35          $ FPA detector readout dissipation (W)
HEADER CONSTANTS DATA
  TIMEO = 0.0, TIMEND = 3600.0, DTIMEI = 15.0
  DRLXCA = 1.0E-7, NLOOP = 300
HEADER EXECUTION
  CALL STDSTL
  CALL CRANKN
HEADER OUTPUT CALLS
  CALL TPRINT
END OF DATA
